note: Resolution and coverage figures describe the native product. A field-scale analysis aggregates these values; they are not field measurements.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 Level-2A (AWS Earth Search STAC)
sources.provider: ESA / Copernicus, mirrored by Element 84 on AWS Open Data
sources.spatial_resolution: 10 m for B04/B08; 20 m for SCL
sources.temporal_resolution: About 5 days with the full constellation; individual fields see fewer usable overpasses
sources.access: Public HTTPS COGs via STAC, no authentication
sources.notes: Primary NDVI source. Cloud/shadow/snow/water masked with SCL. Reflectance offset applied from the processing baseline.

sources.name: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 vegetation indices
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC, mirrored on Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.access: Public COGs via Planetary Computer STAC; SAS token for assets
sources.notes: Coarse regional context. A small field occupies only a few 250 m pixels; results are not field measurements.

sources.name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2
sources.provider: USGS/NASA, mirrored on Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.access: Public COGs via Planetary Computer STAC; SAS token for assets
sources.notes: Longer historical record than Sentinel-2 but coarser and with different radiometry. Do not mix sensors into one series without harmonisation.

sources.name: NASA POWER agroclimatology (MERRA-2 based)
sources.spatial_resolution: 0.5 degree latitude x 0.625 degree longitude (about 55 x 60 km)
sources.notes: Regional weather context, not a field weather station. Precipitation is a reanalysis/assimilation product, not GPM IMERG.

sources.name: SoilGrids 2.0
sources.temporal_coverage: Static product (predictions based on legacy soil data)
sources.notes: Predicted values with substantial uncertainty at field scale. Not a substitute for a soil test.

sources.name: SRTM-derived 1-degree elevation tiles (Skadi/Mapzen terrain tiles)
sources.provider: NASA SRTM, packaged by Mapzen/AWS Open Data
sources.license: SRTM public domain; tile packaging is openly distributed
sources.notes: Elevation and local slope only. Fallback to Open-Meteo elevation (Copernicus DEM GLO-90) if the tile is unavailable.

sources.name: NASA SMAP soil moisture (explored)
sources.access: NASA Earthdata Login/token and HDF5 tooling for direct retrieval; CMR explored publicly
sources.notes: Explored via NASA CMR and integrated into analysis. Direct SMAP granule retrieval requires Earthdata/HDF5; when unavailable, soil moisture patterns are analyzed as NASA POWER (NASA) water-balance indicators and clearly labeled.

sources.name: GPM IMERG precipitation (explored)
sources.access: NASA Earthdata Login/token and HDF5/NetCDF for direct retrieval; CMR explored publicly
sources.notes: Explored via NASA CMR and integrated into analysis. Direct IMERG retrieval requires Earthdata/HDF5; when unavailable, precipitation is analyzed using NASA POWER (NASA reanalysis/assimilation) as the accessible NASA input and labeled accordingly.

sources.name: NASA ECOSTRESS evapotranspiration / land surface temperature (explored)
sources.access: NASA Earthdata Login/token for direct retrieval; CMR explored publicly
sources.notes: Explored via NASA CMR and integrated into analysis. Direct ECOSTRESS retrieval requires Earthdata; when unavailable, heat and evaporation-stress indicators are derived from NASA POWER temperature/radiation and clearly labeled.

sources.name: NASA GRACE / GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage trends (explored)
sources.access: Public/archival products often require Earthdata/netCDF access; CMR explored publicly
sources.notes: Explored via NASA CMR and integrated into analysis. Direct GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon retrieval requires Earthdata/netCDF access in many environments; when unavailable, long-term water availability trend indicators are analyzed from NASA POWER precipitation and clearly labeled (not direct TWS anomalies).

sources.name: ERA5 / AgERA5 reanalysis
sources.notes: Default weather comes from NASA POWER. AgERA5 is preferable for agricultural variables at 0.1 degree once a CDS key is configured.

sources.name: CropHarvest label database
sources.coverage: 21 source datasets, global but spatially uneven
sources.notes: Only 11 labels fall in a broad Palestine bounding box, 5 of them crop, with no multiclass label. Useful as context/evaluation data, not for identifying the selected field.
